findings.title: Team permission check requires admin AND owner instead of OR
findings.body: isTeamAdminOrOwner is computed with (await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...)). A team admin who is not an owner (and vice-versa) will fail the check and get FORBIDDEN, while the intent and the variable name is admin-or-owner. The operator should be ||. Consequence: legitimate team admins are denied adding guests; the only team users who pass are those satisfying both predicates.

findings.title: Blacklist and duplicate checks are case-sensitive and miss intra-request duplicates
findings.body: blacklistedGuestEmails are lowercased but compared with !blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest) without lowercasing guest, so Blacklisted@Example.com bypasses the blocklist. The same filter compares guest === attendee.email case-sensitively and never de-duplicates guests against each other, while the server schema in addGuests.schema.ts does not enforce uniqueness. Consequence: blocked addresses can be added by changing case, and one request can create duplicate Attendee rows.

findings.title: Email routing uses unfiltered guests list instead of actually-added guests
findings.body: Handler filters to uniqueGuests for the DB insert but calls sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests) with the original input. sendAddGuestsEmails in email-manager.ts uses newGuests.includes(attendee.email) to decide between AttendeeScheduledEmail (new guest) and AttendeeAddGuestsEmail (existing). Consequence: an address that was filtered out because it already attended is still classified as new and gets the wrong full scheduled invite, and case variants/blacklisted entries misroute notifications.

findings.title: Validation error flag never cleared on valid retry
findings.body: handleAdd sets setIsInvalidEmail(true) on failed safeParse but never sets it back to false when validation later succeeds; it is only cleared on cancel. Consequence: after one invalid attempt the 'Emails must be unique and valid' banner stays visible even after the user fixes the addresses and successfully submits.
